sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and face opponents in poor form—Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 games. This should be a straightforward opportunity for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place and level on recent form with a loss, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides looking to climb. AFC Bridgnorth (third) host Eccleshall (fifth) in an intriguing clash between two strong teams, though both have wobbled recently with losses. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and currently on a winning streak, face Wednesfield Community at home as they eye further ground on the top two. Bilston Town continue their fine form at home to Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter in dire straits with six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a mid-table contest, Brereton Social travel to Widnes Town (pointless and struggling), and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a match between two of the division's weakest performers. Crewe's home clash with Allscott Heath offers both sides a chance to gain ground. Midweek on Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
